In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="Date" /> the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Interrogator/Legends|''Interrogator'']] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] carried out an '''attack''' on the [[Unidentified capital city (Qlothos)|capital city]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Qlothos]], suspecting the presence of a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] garrison. Yet, there was no Rebels on the planet and the attack inadvertently caused the [[Death/Legends|deaths]] of almost sixty Imperial citizens, including a prominent [[Unidentified Kuat Drive Yards engineer|engineer]] from [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]].<ref name="TLF" />
